headline: Weyerhaeuser Q3 Results Upheld by Timberlands as Wood Products Soften
summary: Weyerhaeuser posted steady third-quarter 2026 performance in its Timberlands segment, offsetting weakness in the Wood Products business line.
why: Weyerhaeuser is one of the world's largest private owners of timberlands, structured as a real estate investment trust.

impacts.name: Weyerhaeuser Company
impacts.why: Timberlands earnings held steady while Wood Products experienced segment weakness.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
